facts.fact: At that meeting the APD approved a control reference framework, a deliberation empowering its sworn agents to take part in inspection missions and a deliberation on the journalists' professional register, and examined complaints 004-2025, 006-2025 and 007-2025.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: The meeting examined replies of ministerial departments contacted by the APD on compliance with the data protection law and joining the 'BEYANAT-HIMAYE' programme, and an authorisation request from Agence MAADEN Mauritanie for processing and interconnection with the population register.
facts.system: Loi n° 2017-020 on personal data protection

facts.fact: On 19 November 2025 the APD held its ordinary monthly meeting under its president and members with the government commissioner present, and the minute names the president, members and government commissioner.
